- Inventory snapshot (US primary region): ~420 A100-80GB-equivalent slots currently free across dedicated pools for the June window. - Ops ticket created: CP-2029-1187 (soft-hold request, pending capacity manager approval).

Attachments to Ops ticket: quantumbridge_sizing_v1.xlsx (from Marcus), capacity_readout_20290509.csv (internal).
